name: gpu-cron
description: Tiny MLX-trained schedule model with a dependency-free WebGPU runtime

scripts.evaluate:cron: pnpm run prepare:cron-data && pnpm run build && node scripts/evaluate-cron.mjs
scripts.evaluate:cron:holdout: pnpm run prepare:cron-data && pnpm run build && node scripts/evaluate-cron.mjs --holdout
scripts.check: pnpm run check:python && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs && pnpm run build:demo && pnpm run test:production && node scripts/browser-test.mjs && pnpm run prepare:cron-data && node scripts/evaluate-cron.mjs --check && node scripts/size.mjs
scripts.export:onnx: uv run --locked --project training --group verification python training/export_onnx.py
scripts.format: prettier --write 'src/**/*.ts' scripts/evaluate-cron.mjs scripts/promote-model.mjs scripts/check-python.mjs scripts/size.mjs && uv run --locked --project training ruff format training
